name: CAP green flight jacket (MA-1 / CWU-36/P / CWU-45/P) with blank nametag
size_citation: MIL-J-8279G, Military Specification: Jacket, Cold Weather (type MA-1), 18 Mar 1988, Table V p. 19 (finished measurements, size Medium) and Table IV pp. 7-9 (pocket flap, pocket, cigarette/pencil pocket); read from the page images.
size_basis: Medium: back length 22 1/2, 1/2 chest 26, 1/2 bottom 23 1/2, sleeve inseam 16 3/8 in; flap 7 1/2 x 2 3/8 in; cigarette pocket 5 3/4 x 3 1/4 in. Not given by the spec and therefore ESTIMATED: collar and knit heights, armhole depth, shoulder width, sleeve girth, flap lean, patch positions on the chest. Shape follows CAPR 39-1 Figure 8.3.

flag.drawn: in the garment image (flat sleeve view and, clipped to the arm, the front view)
flag.orientation: normal: canton (union) toward the wearer's front / the viewer's left on the outer face of the left sleeve; the reversed flag is for the right sleeve, which this reg does not give a flag
flag.basis: CAPR 39-1 8.2.4.4 / 8.3.4.4 (left sleeve only); orientation convention per DAFI 36-2903 (flag worn so the union leads forward; reversed on the right shoulder)
flag.loop_tape_left: not drawn: the 3 1/2 in loop tape on the left is the same colour as the garment and invisible
flag.loop_square_right: drawn as the right-sleeve patch slot (8.2.5.5 / 8.3.5.5)

optional_landmarks.pen_pocket_left: cigarette/pencil pocket on the left sleeve (MA-1 spec)
optional_landmarks.es_patch_zone: optional patch; the jacket is configured like the FDU/CFDU (8.2.7.1 / 6.1.7)
optional_landmarks.grade_zone_left: officers only (8.2.3.2 / 8.3.3.2 / 6.1.7); NCOs and cadets wear no grade

zipper_note: 8.2.7.1: flight jackets are required to be zipped at least halfway; anchors.zipper_min_closed is that height. The artwork shows it fully closed.
views_note: Front view plus a flat view of each sleeve (flag and pocket on the left, loop-tape slot on the right), as for the FDU; a presentation decision, not a regulation requirement.
landmarks_note: rects are {x,y,w,h}; polygons are [[x,y]...]; user units (0.01 in), origin top-left of the artwork box. Right/left = wearer's. Zones with no artwork are invisible placement landmarks.
documented: green flight jacket (MA-1, CWU-36/P, CWU-45/P) is the only authorized outer garment with the FDU (8.2.7, Figure 8.3)
CAP Command Patch, US flag, grade (officers) and nametag are mandatory (8.2.7.1)
nametag 2 x 4 in on the wearer's left breast; CAP Command Patch on the right breast opposite it (8.2.4)
left sleeve flag 2 x 3 1/2 in with gold border, 1/2 in below the seam (8.2.4.4)
right sleeve: authorized patch on a 3 1/2 x 3 1/2 in loop square (8.2.4.5, 8.2.5.5)
officer grade centred on top of each shoulder (8.2.3.2)
assumed: collar and knit band heights, armhole depth, shoulder width, sleeve girth (not in the spec table)
flap lean and pocket positions (from Figure 8.3)
ES patch zone position (jacket has no breast pocket)
orange lining colour and sage-green shade
figure draws a round patch on the right sleeve; shown here as the loop square because 8.2.5.5 applies the FDU configuration
